title: The StreamlitCallbackHandler output of langchain React Agent is missing the “Thought ” part.
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

![企业微信截图_48ebaae7-a48e-4c67-b137-112bb8929e8b](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/57d5f421-145d-4ff9-bfee-a97412c52751)
![企业微信截图_e67b4949-bf30-4268-915f-9c4a01afef60](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/dda458f0-232a-4e2b-b23a-8dab3bd03964)

I am using the React agent framework of langchain and displaying the execution process on the web interface using the StreamlitCallbackHandler. However, I cannot see the relevant information of Agent Thought on the web interface, as shown in the red box in the figure. But I can see it when printing locally. Could you please advise on how to display all the reasoning information of the Agent on the web interface? I have referred to the approach in https://blog.langchain.dev/langchain-streamlit/, but the problem still persists.

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
import requests
from typing import Any, List, Mapping, Optional, Dict

from langchain.callbacks.manager import CallbackManagerForLLMRun
from langchain.llms.base import LLM

from langchain.tools import BaseTool
from langchain.agents import initialize_agent
from langchain_community.llms.utils import enforce_stop_tokens
import json
import streamlit as st
from langchain_community.callbacks.streamlit import (
    StreamlitCallbackHandler,
)


# self-define tools
class WeatherTool(BaseTool):
    name = "Weather"
    description = "Use to search weather condition."

    def _run(self, query: str) -> str:
        return "raining"

class CustomCalculatorTool(BaseTool):
    name = "Calculator"
    description = "Use for calculation."

    def _run(self, query: str) -> str:
        return "3"

weather = WeatherTool()
calculator = CustomCalculatorTool()
tools = [weather, calculator]

# Initial agent
query = "How about today's weather?"
llm = QwenLLM()
agent = initialize_agent(tools, llm, agent="zero-shot-react-description", verbose=True)
# print(agent)
# print(agent.run(query))

if prompt := st.chat_input("Input"):
    with st.chat_message("user", avatar='🧑‍💻'):
        st.markdown(prompt)
    # print(f"[user] {prompt}", flush=True)
    with st.spinner("Processing..."):
        with st.chat_message("assistant", avatar='🤖'):
            try:
                st_callback = StreamlitCallbackHandler(st.container())
                res = agent.run(prompt, callbacks=[st_callback])
                st.write(res)
            except Exception as e:
                st.write("exception：{}".format(str(e)))
    st.button("Clear")
```


### Steps To Reproduce

execute the code.

### Expected Behavior

no info.

### Current Behavior

no info

### Is this a regression?

- [X] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version:1.38.0
- Python version:3.12
- Operating System:

- langchain==0.1.20
- langchain-community==0.0.38
- langchain-core ==0.1.52
- langchain-experimental==0.0.49
- langchain-text-splitters==0.0.2
- langchainhub ==0.1.21
